title: feat(geometry): import DXF splines and ellipses as tangent arcs
body:
## What changed

- **SPLINE and ELLIPSE import.** Before this change, a DXF drawing with one SPLINE or ELLIPSE stopped the whole import ("unsupported entity"). Now the DXF reader reads them (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/curves.rs`, `nurbs.rs`, `curve_fit.rs`, `biarc.rs`). It lays each curve as tangent-continuous circular arcs (biarcs) and lines. The output is ordinary `Line` and `Arc` primitives, so the chainer, the profile picks and the wire arc contour of #3937 read it with no change.
  - SPLINE: degree 1 to 11, knots, control points, weights (rational), fit-point count. Evaluation is de Boor in homogeneous coordinates.
  - ELLIPSE: centre, major axis, ratio, start and end parameter. A ratio of 1 gives an exact `Circle` or `Arc`.
  - A degree-1 spline gives its control polygon (split at each corner knot).
- **The tolerance and its side.** `CURVE_TOLERANCE_MM` = 0.001 mm, two-sided (Hausdorff). Each fitted piece is checked: each curve point is within 1 µm of the arcs, and each arc point is within 1 µm of the curve. Between the samples, a bound on the curve speed covers the curve side, and the unit speed of the arcs covers the arc side. Speed bound: the derivative control polygon (non-rational spline), `2p (wmax / wmin) D / span` (rational spline), the semi-major axis (ellipse). The output is on no fixed side of the curve. 1 µm is less than half of the wire cover law tolerance (2 µm). An arc with a radius above `CURVE_MAX_RADIUS_MM` (1000 mm) becomes a line, and the same check applies to it.
- **Units.** The bound is in millimetres. A drawing without `$INSUNITS` is read as inches (the largest unit the application lets a caller state), so the bound in drawing units is the tightest. `Document::curve_tolerance` keeps the used value. `SketchData::from_dxf` refuses (`SketchError::CurveTolerance`) when the applied unit makes the bound looser than 1 µm.
- **Refused by name, never clamped.** Degree, knot count, knot order, empty domain, knot multiplicity, weight count, zero / negative / non-finite weights, weight ratio over 1e6, control or fit points in two Z planes (an omitted Z is 0), an orphan or duplicate Z of a control or fit point, counts over the vertex limit (checked before the values are read), fit points without control points, ellipse ratio outside (0, 1], zero axis, zero sweep, parameter over 1e6, tilted axis or extrusion. A curve that needs more evaluations than the drawing budget (50 million) is refused before the work starts. A cusp that 40 halvings cannot fit is refused.
- **INSERT and POINT decision.** They do not stop the import now. Each is skipped and counted in `summary.skipped` (an INSERT with attributes takes its ATTRIB records up to SEQEND). Block expansion is not in this PR; it stays open on #1865. A selected-chain wire cut still refuses a drawing with a skipped INSERT or POINT by name, as for HATCH: the block geometry is not read, so its clearance from the wire cannot be checked.
- **Provenance cleanup (separate small item).** The provenance lines of `crates/post/src/agie/{mod,cutoff,group}.rs`, `crates/post/src/agie_setup.rs`, `agie_setup/{cutoff,group,quality,piece}.rs`, `agie_setup/inspection/piece.rs`, `docs/decisions/2966-agie-fine-quality.md`, and the licence section heading in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` and `site/static/icons/LICENSES.txt` no longer name the tool they came from. They say "our own implementation". The MIT licence text stays. The public sources that the lines also name stay. `agie_setup/piece.rs` was added in commit `ae5b858f5` (it was missed before): its provenance line named the tool and a person, and now says "our own implementation of the piece format".
- **Build fix carried.** `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs` on main does not compile (`WireContourOp` has no `start` field, #3952). This branch carries the same hunks as PR #3953 (by mkinney), so the suite builds. When #3953 merges first, the merge is clean.
- Decision file: `docs/decisions/1865-dxf-spline-ellipse.md`.

## Readings

- Closed cubic SPLINE (fixture `crates/geometry/tests/dxf/spline.dxf`, about 80 mm long): 72 segments, measured Hausdorff 4.1e-4 mm against an independent Cox-de Boor evaluation (bound 1e-3 mm).
- The same spline as a wire die (hole at its centre, generic ISO wire post): 73 `G3` blocks, all laws clean (`verdict.findings` empty, slug captured).
- Unitless rational quarter circle of radius 10: at most 8 arcs, each point within 0.001 / 25.4 of the circle.

## Pinning tests

- `camcraft-geometry --test dxf`: `curves::closed_cubic_spline_reads_as_tangent_arcs_within_the_bound`, `curves::rational_quarter_circle_spline_becomes_arcs_on_its_circle`, `curves::degree_one_spline_is_its_control_polygon`, `curves::ellipses_read_as_tangent_arcs_and_a_round_one_stays_a_circle`, `curves::a_slender_ellipse_keeps_the_bound_at_its_tight_ends`, `curves::insert_and_point_are_skipped_and_the_rest_reads`.
- `camcraft-geometry --test dxf_refusals`: `curve_refusals::malformed_splines_are_refused_by_name`, `curve_refusals::malformed_ellipses_are_refused_by_name`, `curve_refusals::mutated_curve_records_never_panic` (300 fixed-seed mutations), `curve_refusals::curves_read_for_a_smaller_unit_than_the_applied_one_are_refused`, and the changed `dxf_unsupported_entities_are_refused_by_name` (INSERT now reads).
- `camcraft-app --test wire_dxf_selection`: `arcs::closed_spline_die_cuts_as_tangent_arcs_and_posts_its_golden` (new golden `wire-iso/wire_dxf_spline_die.nc`), and `arcs::arcs_stay_refused_for_taper_and_a_hatch_still_blocks_the_cut` (now also an INSERT refusal).

## Goldens moved

None. One golden is new: `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/wire-iso/wire_dxf_spline_die.nc`. The six goldens of #3937 and all other goldens are unchanged (the drawings without splines or ellipses read byte for byte as before).

Regenerated after #3988 (merge of main into this branch, commit `1e9840209`): the golden is still added (A) against main. #3988 joins tangent arcs with no zero-length connector. Thus the 72 `G1` blocks that did not move are gone. The 73 `G3` blocks and their I/J centres are unchanged, and the diff has deletions only. Each motion block of the golden now moves the wire (1 `G0`, 2 `G1` for the lead-in and the lead-out, 73 `G3`).

## Not exercised

- No physical cut and no control run of a spline program.
- Sodick and G-EDM goldens for the spline (the arc blocks are the same code path as #3937).
- Splines with only fit points (refused), periodic splines whose control points do not wrap (they read as an open chain), and block expansion.
- The zero-length `G1` after each arc (an output defect of the #3937 arc path) is fixed on main by #3988. The golden was regenerated after that merge and has no such block now.

## Review fixes (review of head `ed5d85de4`)

1. **Coordinate completeness (blocking).** Fixed by the reviewer in `62b3fdf17`. Each control point is X, Y and at most one Z. An omitted Z is 0. Orphan Z, duplicate Z and points in two Z planes are refused by name. Pinned by `curve_refusals::spline_control_points_use_a_per_point_z_default` and `curve_refusals::spline_control_points_refuse_orphan_and_duplicate_z`.
2. **Equal weights are found once (optional).** `Nurbs::new` sets `uniform` one time. `speed()` reads it and does not scan the weights for each span. 40,000 collinear control points (debug build): 13.8 s before, 0.5 s after. Pinned by `curve_bounds::a_long_non_rational_spline_reads_in_linear_time` (bound 5 s).
3. **Near-round ellipse (optional).** A ratio of exactly 1 is the exact circle, with no recorded tolerance. Below 1, the reader uses the circle only when `radius * (1 - ratio)` is within the tolerance in drawing units, and then records the tolerance. Otherwise it fits arcs. Pinned by `curve_bounds::a_near_round_ellipse_is_a_circle_only_within_the_tolerance` (both sides of the bound, and the review case at radius 1e10 mm).

Both `curve_bounds` tests failed on `62b3fdf17` and pass on `8973feb08`.

4. **Fit point elevation (same finding class as item 1).** Fixed in `1359ef98e`. The fit points (group codes 11/21/31) now follow the control point rule of `62b3fdf17`: each fit point is X, Y and at most one Z, and an omitted Z is 0. A Z before X and Y, a duplicate Z, a Y before X and an X with no Y are refused by name. All fit points and all control points must be in one Z plane, else the SPLINE is refused with "fit points are not in one Z plane". Before this fix, the reader ignored group codes 21 and 31, so a fit Z off the plane was not checked. Pinned by `curve_refusals::spline_fit_points_use_a_per_point_z_default` (a fit-only spline with one explicit Z of 1 and one omitted Z, in both orders; all omitted reads at 0; all equal explicit reads at 2; a mixed fit Z and a fit plane that differs from the control plane are refused) and `curve_refusals::spline_fit_points_refuse_orphan_and_duplicate_z`. Both tests failed on `8973feb08` and pass on `1359ef98e`.

## Gate

On head `ae5b858f5` (merge of main `d80dc6944`, regenerated spline golden, piece provenance line):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 1212 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 31.9 min. The log names head `ae5b858f585a16aae26de0ab027fd4b14d603335`. The plan holds `wire_dxf_selection`, `example_catalog*`, `dxf`, `dxf_refusals`, the ui suites and the clippy step.
- Strict clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light --only "motion light" --only "app light"`: 5 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3958 --reviewed 1359ef98e`: NEW CODE (the merge `641ac0448` with `wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs` resolved by hand, the golden commit `1e9840209`, the provenance commit `ae5b858f5`).

On head `1359ef98e` (the fit point fix):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 1206 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, wall 30.3 min. The plan holds every app suite (the `example_catalog*` suites included), `wire_dxf_selection`, `dxf`, `dxf_refusals`, the ui suites and the clippy step.
- Strict clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light --only "motion light" --only "app light"`: 5 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- The branch merges cleanly with `origin/main` (`97a676e5c`), so no merge commit was necessary.

On head `8973feb08` the same three commands were green (quick: 1206 steps, 0 failed, wall 30.2 min).

Heavy: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` reaches 106 steps (geometry is shared). This issue is `P4`, not `P1`, so no heavy step runs ("Heavy lanes at review").

## Review fix

- SPLINE import checks each control point when the next point starts or the record ends. An omitted Z is zero for that point. The reader rejects an orphan or duplicate Z and rejects points in different Z planes.
- `spline_control_points_use_a_per_point_z_default` covers a missing Z in both orders. It also covers zero and equal explicit elevations. `spline_control_points_refuse_orphan_and_duplicate_z` covers orphan, out-of-order and duplicate Z fields.
- Pin proof. Both tests failed on `ed5d85de4` with the new tests and the old parser. Both passed with the fix. `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test dxf --test dxf_refusals` passed all 44 tests.

### Gates on `62b3fdf174b4c02278ce03fa1c2e5d4ee33c7e25`

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` ran 1,206 steps. 1,203 passed, 3 failed, and 0 stalled. The red steps were `ui suites: lib`, `ui suites: egui_app`, and `ui suites: shell`. They match the missing graphics adapter failures from the prior review.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` ran 106 steps. 105 passed, 1 failed, and 0 stalled. The red step was `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`. The test `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` read counts of 4,688 moves, 4,660 planar moves, and 1,980 fitted arcs. Its pin expects 3,158, 3,130, and 1,141. The same release test failed with the same counts and diagnostic when run with the original parser from `ed5d85de4`.
- Both gate commands started against upstream main `d94b9816d`. Upstream advanced during the runs. The merge base with the fix stayed at `98caf2dfd`, so the selected diff stayed the same.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. The quick gate also passed its batch Clippy step.
- The debug example catalog passed 41 tests. The heavy catalog passed its other 4 tests. The adaptive and edge-work catalog suites also passed. The conformance (7), solid-law (7), wire DXF (7), and wire decimal (2) suites passed.

### Goldens moved in this fix

None. The catalog and golden suites passed. The spline die golden already in the PR passed its byte comparison.

No physical cut was run. The fix changes the DXF reader and tests, so there are no UI screenshots.

Effort: max (as the issue #1865 is labelled; this PR is its SPLINE and ELLIPSE part).

Changelog: DXF import reads SPLINE and ELLIPSE entities as tangent arcs within 1 µm, so a drawing with a spline or an ellipse no longer stops the import and its curves can feed a wire contour; INSERT and POINT entities are skipped and counted instead of stopping the import.
